Ravi (CSM): Quick heads-up — account 'Pioneer' spiked tokens in last 24h during onboarding. QBR Fri. Need a 3-bullet cost mitigation for the deck. Internal notes: https://redwood.internal/pioneer-onboard

Elena (AM): Noted. Initial signal shows embeddings + a nightly full reindex job peaking. Pulling 7d per-route counts now.

alert-bot: ALERT: Account=Pioneer projected to exceed monthly commit by 31% within 4d. Top contributors: embeddings=67%, reindex=21%.

Marco (FinOps): Please paste the 7d token totals so I can run $ projection. Suggest temporary hard cap at 120% commit to avoid bill shock.

Ivy (Solutions Eng): Quick remediation I can validate: 1) pause nightly full reindex for 48h; 2) enable per-account prefix KV cache; 3) set embedding_batch_limit=200. I can run a 90m staging test and report token delta.

Elena (AM): Draft QBR bullets for Ravi to use:
- Immediate: paused nightly reindex to stop bulk ingestion (owner: Elena)
- Short-term: enabled prefix KV cache + reduced embedding batch size to 200 (owner: Ivy)
- Policy: added 70% budget webhook + FinOps review + temporary 120% cap (owner: Marco)
I'll present the slide. :thumbsup:

Ravi (CSM): Great — I'll add these to the deck and create the ticket. ETA: slide update by EOD.

alert-bot: TICKET #CS-11077 created: 'Pioneer onboarding spend triage' (owner: Elena)
